digest.component_or_area: configuration system and duplicate ticket detection
propositions: verify.overlap_enabled is renamed to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets to reflect the output (link suggestions) rather than internal mechanism (overlap detection)
The old TOML key and env var names are kept as permanent aliases via _ALIASES dict and _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES mapping, with no deprecation timeline
docs/config.md lacks any entry for the overlap detection feature despite it being production-ready and token-consuming, creating an operator documentation gap
When both legacy and canonical config keys/env vars are present, the canonical value takes precedence and the legacy entry is dropped
The rename requires updates to five source modules (config schema, deprecation registry, config sources, two LLM consumers) plus documentation and tests
